content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to CAPM Certification in Palmdale

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you hold a secondary degree (high school diploma, associate degree, or global equivalent) and can document the required project management education hours. CAPM requires no prior work experience, making it accessible to career-changers and early-career professionals in Palmdale's aerospace and defense sector.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Hours of Instruction
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot camp. Our intensive format covers the PMBOK® Guide framework and project management fundamentals in a concentrated schedule designed for working professionals who need flexibility without sacrificing depth.

steps_items.heading: Submit PMI Application
steps_items.text: Register with PMI and submit your official application, including proof of your secondary degree and completion of the required education hours from Granite PM Academy. Payment of the PMI examination fee is processed as part of this step.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Leverage Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, practice questions, and review sessions to strengthen your readiness. You will take the CAPM examination through PMI's testing partner at an approved test center, on your schedule.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: Earn professional development units (PDUs) throughout each three-year renewal cycle to keep your CAPM active. Granite PM Academy offers continuing education opportunities to help you stay current and advance toward PMP certification when ready.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.

fq_items.question: Is this training delivered online?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Our CAPM training is fully live-virtual — no travel required. {city} students attend via video conference from wherever they are.
